prng.note: Chosen for portability and auditability: no hidden state, no dependence on any engine built-in RNG.

seeds.allocation: handed out in fixed opening-id order, one per attempt, incrementing by one
seeds.note: Opening-construction seeds. Not drawn from the research evaluation seed ledger; nothing there is consumed.

constraints.timing_set: openings 200…209, never used in the match
constraints.uniqueness: canonical position key over sorted pegs, sorted bridges and side to move
constraints.exclusions: terminal, or fewer than two legal continuations
constraints.retry_rule: on rejection the seed is recorded with a reason and the next seed is drawn

summary.rejected_seeds_note: Zero is expected, not a disabled rule: a four-ply opening cannot end a game on a 24x24 board, always leaves hundreds of continuations, and collisions among 210 four-move sequences drawn from ~528 options are vanishingly unlikely. The rejection predicate is exercised directly in tests/product_match/test_openings.mjs.
summary.side_to_move_note: Uniformly red: four plies is an even number, so red is always to move. This introduces no bias, because every opening is played twice with the colours swapped (specification §4 pairing).
